params.caption: Hindi ghazal, ghazal. Tender, reflective, graceful. Soft intimate female vocal with subtle ornaments and unhurried phrasing, sung in Hindi. Harmonium, sarangi, tabla and sparse fingerpicked acoustic guitar. Harmonium aalap, refrain matla, tabla verses, sarangi interlude, refrain final chorus, harmonium outro. Intimate acoustic recording, warm reverb, sparse arrangement. graceful melodic turns with light ornaments, breathing space between lines. Vocal forward, natural phrasing.
